version_notes: The source is Chapter 3 of Haihan Yu’s 2023 dissertation. The chapter lists Haihan Yu, Mark S. Kaiser and Daniel J. Nordman and states that it is modified from a manuscript under review by The Annals of Statistics.

The manuscript title says A composite empirical likelihood method rather than the published A blockwise empirical likelihood method. Its authors, matching abstract and explicit Annals submission identify it as the corresponding author-manuscript version.
The manuscript’s printed numbering is preserved. Equivalence of every theorem or condition to the final 2024 article is not asserted; a final-journal copy remains useful for reconciliation.

Only the Chapter 3 main text and references on PDF pages 99–136 (printed 89–126) are admitted. Its Appendix A starts on PDF page 137, heading y=110.645195, and all chapter appendix mathematics is excluded. Other dissertation chapters are outside scope.
The original 295-page institutional PDF is pinned as a whole; no altered extracted PDF is substituted.
